notes: The weekly sync is a recurring event, not a loop. The client review date is a fact; the loop is adding notes before it.

items.title: Send Hannah the revised Q4 deck
items.quote: Can you send me the revised Q4 deck by Monday at 8am?
items.note: 0.90. 8:00 AM JST Mon Oct 26 = 23:00Z Sun Oct 25.

items.title: Hannah to forward the vendor contacts
items.quote: I'll forward the vendor contacts by noon on Tuesday.
items.note: Written by Hannah, so owner other. 0.80 + 0.05 + 0.05 + 0.05 modal = 0.95. Noon JST = 03:00Z.

items.title: Add notes to the shared doc before the client review
items.quote: Please add your notes to the shared doc before Friday, October 30.
items.note: 0.90. Weekday matches the date (Oct 30, 2026 is a Friday).
